spec: code/specs/task-app-data-model.md, "Typed names are trimmed of Unicode White_Space"
about: How a typed name or label is trimmed before it is stored. `whiteSpace` is every Unicode White_Space code point, in hex; each host's trim must remove exactly these from a one-character name and keep every other code point. Each case types `typed` into every name composer of a fresh app (Add Task, the edit-task field's Save, the Sheet Name cell, a new label, the Sheet Labels cell, a new project, a new checklist and a new checklist item) and checks what was stored. `stored` is the name every composer must store; null means the trimmed name is empty, so every composer must refuse it or do nothing, exactly as it does for an empty field. task-mosaic-app's native test and the web host's test both run every case, so the two hosts cannot drift apart. Invisible characters are written as \u escapes.

cases.name: NEXT LINE is White_Space (JS trim keeps it)
ZERO WIDTH NO-BREAK SPACE is not White_Space (JS trim strips it)
ZERO WIDTH NO-BREAK SPACE trailing, outside a space
ZERO WIDTH NO-BREAK SPACE stops the trim
a name that is only ZERO WIDTH NO-BREAK SPACE is not empty
OGHAM SPACE MARK, EN QUAD to HAIR SPACE, NARROW NBSP, MMSP
mixed, every kind at both ends
ZERO WIDTH SPACE is not White_Space
MONGOLIAN VOWEL SEPARATOR is not White_Space
only NEXT LINE is empty (JS trim keeps it)
